app.name: Saqient Compliance Workspace
app.subtitle: Compliance Workspace
app.demoBanner: Demo mode: this workspace contains synthetic demonstration data. Synthetic demonstration content — not legal guidance.
app.footerDisclaimer: Saqient supports human document review. It does not provide legal advice or certify legal or regulatory compliance.

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.syntheticNotice: Synthetic demonstration content — not legal guidance.
common.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?
common.notFoundHint: The page or record does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

auth.signInHint: Sign in to your review workspace to continue.
auth.heroTitle: Document reviews your team can trace, step by step.
auth.heroBody: Run versioned checklists against your documents, inspect the evidence behind each finding, and record every reviewer decision.

checklists.title: Versioned checklists
checklists.body: Each review is pinned to one checklist version and one document version.

evidence.title: Evidence you can open
evidence.body: Findings link to the page or paragraph of the stored document text.

signoff.title: People make the decisions
signoff.body: Automated checks are a first pass. Reviewers confirm, dismiss and sign off.

auth.forgotHint: Enter your account email. If an account exists, we send a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires soon.
auth.resetHint: Choose a password of at least 12 characters. Signing in elsewhere ends when you save it.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed and all sessions were signed out. Sign in with your new password.
auth.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Counts from your organisation's data. These are operational counts, not a measure of compliance.
overview.coverageDefinition: The proportion of checklist items reviewed.
overview.nothingToDecideHint: New findings from checklist runs will appear here.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description_page: Upload PDF (with extractable text), DOCX or TXT files. Files are stored privately and processed in the background.
documents.emptyHint: Upload a document to start a review.
documents.noMalwareScan: Uploaded files are validated by type and signature but are not scanned for malware.
documents.textUnavailable: Extracted text will appear here once processing succeeds.
documents.refsParagraph: References use paragraph numbers (this format has no fixed pages).
documents.deleteDescription: Stored files and extracted text for every version are deleted. The audit trail keeps a record that the document existed. Documents used in a review cannot be deleted.
documents.retentionNote: Deleting a document removes its files and extracted text immediately. Database backups follow your backup retention schedule.
documents.malwareScanned: Uploaded files are validated by type and signature and scanned for malware before they are stored.

upload.title: Upload document
upload.hint: PDF, DOCX or TXT. Scanned PDF pages are read with OCR only when your administrator has enabled it; OCR text is labelled and may contain recognition errors.
upload.dropzone: Click to browse or drag a file here

jobs.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested. The job stops at the next safe point.

checklists.title: Checklists
checklists.description: Versioned review criteria. Reviews stay linked to the exact version they used.
checklists.kindsExplainer: Checklists are kept separate by kind: synthetic demonstration checklists, organisation-authored internal policies, and external regulatory requirements (only with a verified source).
checklists.emptyHint: Checklist authoring in the app is planned for the next phase.
checklists.authoringNote: Read-only view. Editing checklists in the app is planned for the next phase; publishing always creates a new immutable version.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Each review runs one published checklist version against a document version, finance datasets, or both.
reviews.newHint: Choose a published checklist and the inputs to check: a processed document, ready datasets, or both. Deterministic checks start immediately.
reviews.versionPinned: The review stays linked to this version even if the checklist changes later.
reviews.emptyHint: Start a review from a processed document or a ready dataset.
reviews.oneDatasetPerKind: Choose at most one dataset of each type.
reviews.inputRequired: Choose a document, a dataset, e-invoices or an entity.
reviews.noReadyInputs: Nothing is ready to review yet. Upload a document or import a dataset first.
reviews.asOfHint: Rules are looked up for this date. If left empty, the latest dataset period end is used.
reviews.unverifiedPackWarning: This rule pack has unverified rules. Results that use them are flagged as unverified.
reviews.noBatches: No e-invoice batches for this entity.
reviews.vatScopeHint: An entity on its own runs the entity-level checks of the checklist. Add e-invoice batches to validate the invoices in them.

reviewDetail.disclaimer: Automated outcomes are a first pass for human review. A text match is not proof of compliance, and a missing match is not automatically a violation.
reviewDetail.allDecided: Every finding has a reviewer decision.
reviewDetail.noFindingsHint: No checks needed attention. Review the check results, or add a manual finding.
reviewDetail.selectFinding: Select a finding to see its evidence beside the document.
reviewDetail.signoffDescription: This records your approval and freezes an immutable report version. Decisions can only change after reopening the review with a reason, which creates a new report version.
reviewDetail.signedOffToast: Review signed off. The report is ready to export.
reviewDetail.reopenDescription: Earlier report versions stay unchanged. Signing off again creates a new report version.
reviewDetail.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 5 characters.
reviewDetail.outcomeNote: Outcomes describe text matches only. Reviewer decisions are recorded on findings.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Findings across all reviews in your organisation.
findings.emptyHint: Findings appear after checks run on a review.
findings.confirmFirst: Confirm the finding before assigning remediation.
findings.noEvidence: No matching text was found in the document. Absence of a match is not automatically a violation; confirm by reading the document.
findings.rationale: Rationale (required to dismiss or accept risk)
findings.rationaleRequired: Give a rationale of at least 5 characters.
findings.lockedSignedOff: The review is signed off. Reopen it with a reason to change decisions.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Remediation on confirmed findings, tax obligations and other follow-up work.
tasks.emptyHint: Tasks appear when a reviewer assigns remediation on a confirmed finding.
tasks.noNotifications: Reminders are shown in the app only; email or chat notifications are not available yet.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Signed-off review reports. Each sign-off creates an immutable version.
reports.emptyHint: Reports appear when a reviewer signs off a review.
reports.noneForReviewHint: Sign off the review to create a report version.
reports.immutableNote: Reports are generated from a frozen snapshot taken at sign-off. Reopening a review never changes an earlier version.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Who did what, and when, in this organisation.
activity.notTamperProof: The activity log is an application record. It is not tamper-proof.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.passwordSessionsNote: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.
settings.aiExplainer: AI is off. Reviews use deterministic checks and human decisions only, and no document content is sent to any external service.
settings.aiExplainerOn: AI suggestions are on. Document text for a review is sent only to the provider configured by your administrator, and only when someone asks for suggestions. A reviewer must accept each suggestion.
settings.aiUnavailableReason: This deployment has no AI provider configured, so the organisation cannot opt in.
settings.aiAdminOnly: Only an organisation admin can change the opt-in.
settings.aiOptInConfirm: After you opt in, document text for a review is sent to the configured model when someone asks for suggestions. Before that, nothing is sent. Every suggestion still needs a reviewer's acceptance before it becomes a finding.
settings.aiOptOutConfirm: No more document text will be sent to the model. Reviews keep working with deterministic checks and human decisions; past suggestions stay in the record.
settings.aiOptedIn: AI suggestions turned on for this organisation.
settings.aiOptedOut: AI suggestions turned off for this organisation.

palette.title: Command menu
palette.placeholder: Search reviews, documents and findings, or type a page name…

ai.title: AI suggestions
ai.explainer: Suggestions are drafts from a model. Nothing becomes a finding until a reviewer accepts it, and an accepted suggestion still needs a normal decision. Quotes are checked against the stored document text; quotes that do not match are removed. A suggestion is not legal advice and not a compliance decision.
ai.mockNotice: Mock provider: these are placeholder suggestions for testing the workflow. They are not analysis.
ai.failed: AI suggestions could not be prepared. The review itself is not affected. {{error}}
ai.nowDisabled: AI is now turned off for this workspace. Earlier suggestions stay visible for the record.
ai.emptyHint: Ask the model to read the document against each checklist requirement. You decide what to keep.
ai.disabledHint: An administrator has not enabled an AI provider for this workspace.
ai.pendingCount_one: {{count}} possible gap waits for a reviewer.
ai.pendingCount_other: {{count}} possible gaps wait for a reviewer.
ai.noneShown: No suggestions to show with this filter.
ai.noQuotes: No supporting quote was found in the document.
ai.rejectedCitations_one: {{count}} quote did not match the document and was removed.
ai.rejectedCitations_other: {{count}} quotes did not match the document and were removed.
ai.findingOrigin: Started as an AI suggestion from {{model}} and added by a reviewer. It still needs a reviewer decision.
ai.signedOffHint: Reopen the review to ask for suggestions.

ocr.hint: Read by OCR from a scanned page. Check the original before relying on this text.
ocr.confidence: Read by OCR (confidence {{pct}}%). Check the original before relying on this text.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid, has expired or was already used. Ask your administrator for a new one.
invite.existingHint: You already have an account. Enter its password to join.
invite.signedInAsOther: You are signed in as {{email}}. Accepting adds the invited address, not this account.

members.hint: People who can access this organisation.
members.hintAdmin: Change roles, remove members and invite people by email. An organisation always keeps at least one admin.
members.removeDescription: {{name}} loses access to this organisation and is signed out here. Their past decisions stay in the audit log.
members.inviteNotDelivered: The invitation was saved but the email could not be delivered. Use Resend after checking mail settings.
members.resent: Invitation resent with a new link.

entities.title: Legal entities
entities.description: Companies whose finance data you import. Tax numbers are stored encrypted and shown masked.
entities.formHint: Fiscal year end and time zone decide which period a dataset belongs to.
entities.name: Name
entities.countryRule: Use a two-letter ISO country code, such as AE or SA.
entities.currencyRule: Use a three-letter ISO currency code, such as AED.
entities.trnHint: Optional. Stored encrypted; only the last four characters are shown.
entities.trnKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored number.
entities.archiveDescription: {{name}} is hidden from lists and new imports. Its datasets and reviews are kept.
entities.emptyHint: An organisation admin adds entities before datasets can be imported.
entities.emptyHintAdmin: Add the companies whose finance data you will import.
entities.taxGroupsHint: Entities that file together under a group registration.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: Trial balances, ledgers, registers and bank statements. Each upload is hashed and kept as a version.
datasets.uploadHint: CSV or XLSX, or MT940 / CAMT.053 for bank statements. You confirm the column mapping before anything is checked.
datasets.name: Name
datasets.periodOrder: The end date must be on or after the start date.
datasets.emptyHint: Import a trial balance, ledger, register or bank statement to run data checks.
datasets.readyHint: Ready to use as review input.
datasets.mappingHint: Match each field to a column in your file. Suggestions come from the header names; check them before confirming.
datasets.requireAny: Map at least one complete set: {{groups}}.
datasets.previewHint: First rows of the file exactly as read, before mapping.
datasets.previewPending: The preview appears once the file has been read.
datasets.noPreview: No preview is available for this file.
datasets.errorsShown: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} rejected values.

rulePacks.title: Rule packs
rulePacks.description: Rates, thresholds and dates used by data checks, kept as versioned data with their sources.
rulePacks.verificationNote: Rules start as draft. Only an organisation admin can mark a rule verified, and only with an official source URL and no open question. Reports flag every unverified rule a check used.
rulePacks.newHint: The pack starts with an empty draft version.
rulePacks.name: Name
rulePacks.jurisdictionHint: ISO country code (AE, SA, AE-DU) or SYNTHETIC for demonstration data.
rulePacks.jurisdictionRule: Use a country code such as AE or SA-01, or SYNTHETIC.
rulePacks.emptyHint: A reviewer or admin creates a pack and enters each rule with its source.
rulePacks.unverifiedHint: No person has checked this rule against its official source.
rulePacks.unverifiedBanner: This version contains unverified rules. Checks that use them say so in the review and the report.
rulePacks.publishDescription: Published versions cannot be edited. The previous published version is archived.
rulePacks.publishUnverified_one: Published versions cannot be edited. {{count}} rule is still unverified and will be flagged wherever it is used.
rulePacks.publishUnverified_other: Published versions cannot be edited. {{count}} rules are still unverified and will be flagged wherever they are used.
rulePacks.draftHint: Edit rules here, save, then publish.
rulePacks.ruleFormHint: Enter the value exactly as the source states it. Changing a verified rule returns it to draft.
rulePacks.ruleKeyRule: Lowercase letters and digits, separated by dots or underscores.
rulePacks.dateOrder: Must be on or after the start date.
rulePacks.todoHint: Anything still to confirm. A rule with an open question cannot be verified.
rulePacks.noRulesHint: Add each rate, threshold or date with its source.

einvoices.title: E-invoices
einvoices.description: Stored e-invoice XML files, grouped by upload batch.
einvoices.notSent: Nothing on this page is sent to any e-invoicing platform or tax authority. Saqient stores the XML you upload and validates it only when you create a review; the results are proposed findings for a person to decide on.
einvoices.uploadHint: One XML invoice, or a ZIP of XML invoices. Each file is hashed and stored exactly as uploaded.
einvoices.emptyHint: Upload invoice XML exported from your invoicing system, then validate it in a review.
einvoices.validateHint: To validate these invoices, create a review and choose this batch.
einvoices.monitorsHint: On a schedule, a monitor samples e-invoices uploaded for one entity since its last run and creates a review for them.
einvoices.monitorHint: Each run takes a seeded random sample, so the same inputs always give the same sample.
einvoices.sampleHint: Invoices validated per run, from 1 to 500.
einvoices.sampleRule: Enter a whole number from 1 to 500.
einvoices.noMonitorsDecider: No monitors yet. Create one to sample new e-invoices on a schedule.

taxCalendar.title: Tax calendar
taxCalendar.description: Filing and payment due dates computed from rule packs, each with a task.
taxCalendar.generateHint: Computes obligations for one entity from a published rule pack. Running it again updates changed dates and leaves the others as they are.
taxCalendar.unverifiedPack: This rule pack has unverified rules. Dates computed from them are flagged as unverified.
taxCalendar.prefixHint: The calendar reads <prefix>.obligations from the rule pack.
taxCalendar.draftNote: Dates come from rule packs. Do not rely on a date computed from a draft (unverified) rule until an organisation admin has verified that rule against its official source. Saqient does not file returns or make payments.
taxCalendar.emptyHint: Obligations appear when a reviewer or admin generates the calendar for an entity.
taxCalendar.emptyHintDecider: Generate the calendar for an entity from a published rule pack.

generalTasks.newHint: A task for follow-up work that is not a finding.
generalTasks.emptyHint: Tax obligation tasks appear when the tax calendar is generated. Anyone with write access can add a manual task.
generalTasks.dueFixed: The due date of a tax obligation comes from the rule pack and cannot be changed here.
generalTasks.noteHint: Optional. Saved in the task history.
generalTasks.closingNoteHint: Required to close a task, for example the filing reference.
generalTasks.noteRequired: Add a note to close this task, for example the filing reference.

taxSetup.title: Tax setup · {{name}}
taxSetup.description: VAT and e-invoicing settings that checks use for this entity.
taxSetup.basisHint: The revenue figure places the entity in an e-invoicing wave defined in the rule pack. Enter it as stated in your records.
taxSetup.amountRule: Use digits with up to 4 decimal places.
taxSetup.goLiveOverride: Go-live date notified to this taxpayer
taxSetup.goLiveHint: Only if the authority notified this entity of its own date. Leave empty to use the rule pack.
taxSetup.goLiveNoteRequired: Say where the notified date comes from.
taxSetup.codesHint: Map each ERP tax code to a VAT treatment, and name the GL accounts that hold VAT. Saving replaces the whole setup.

directTax.title: Direct tax
directTax.description: Corporate tax, small business relief, free zone, Pillar Two and zakat workpapers, the tax loss register and transfer pricing records.
directTax.disclaimer: Results on these pages are indications for a qualified reviewer. They are not tax advice, a filed return or a statement that any entity is compliant. Nothing here is sent to a tax authority.
directTax.indicationNote: Calculated lines are proposals for a qualified reviewer to check against the evidence and the rule sources. They are not a final tax position.
directTax.chooseEntityHint: The loss register and transfer pricing records are kept per legal entity.
directTax.warningsHint: At least one value comes from a draft rule that no person has verified against its official source. Do not rely on it until the rule is verified.
directTax.unverifiedPack: This rule pack version contains draft (unverified) rules. Results that use them will carry an unverified-rule warning.
directTax.rulesPrefixHint: The rule key prefix in the chosen pack, for example the part before .rate. Lowercase letters, digits, underscores and dots.
directTax.positiveAmountRule: Enter an amount greater than zero, with up to 4 decimal places.
directTax.amountRule: Enter an amount of zero or more, with up to 4 decimal places.
directTax.signedAmountRule: Enter an amount with up to 4 decimal places (a minus sign is allowed).

workpapers.newHint: A workpaper collects inputs for one entity and period and computes them with a published rule pack version.
workpapers.currencyHint: Optional. Defaults to the entity's functional currency.
workpapers.currencyRule: Use a three-letter ISO 4217 code, for example AED.
workpapers.emptyHint: Workpapers appear here once an analyst or reviewer creates one.
workpapers.emptyHintWriter: Create a workpaper to collect inputs and compute an indication for one entity and period.
workpapers.inputsHint: Amounts and flags entered by a preparer. Changing an input clears the computed lines.
workpapers.inputsLocked: This workpaper is signed off. Reopen it to change inputs.
workpapers.noInputsHint: Add the amounts and flags the calculation needs.
workpapers.inputHint: Each input has a stable key that the calculation reads.
workpapers.lineKeyHint: Starts with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
workpapers.lineKeyRule: Use a lowercase key such as accounting_profit (up to 80 characters).
workpapers.label: Label
workpapers.evidenceKept_one: The {{count}} evidence reference on this input is kept.
workpapers.evidenceKept_other: The {{count}} evidence references on this input are kept.
workpapers.removeDescription: "{{name}}" will be removed and the computed lines cleared.
workpapers.resultsHint: Open a line to see each step, the formula and the rules it read.
workpapers.signOffDescription: An immutable snapshot of the inputs and computed lines is stored. Inputs are locked until the workpaper is reopened.
workpapers.signOffUnverified: This workpaper used unverified rules. Signing off records your review; it does not verify the rules. An immutable snapshot is stored and inputs are locked.
workpapers.reopenHint: Earlier snapshots are kept. The next sign-off creates a new version.
workpapers.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.
workpapers.prefilled: Loss inputs filled from the register.
workpapers.postDescription: Losses incurred or used in this signed-off workpaper are recorded in the entity's loss register.
workpapers.snapshotsHint: Each sign-off stores an immutable version that can be exported.
workpapers.prepared: Marked prepared. A different reviewer can now sign it off.
workpapers.leadsReloaded: Lead balances reloaded from the lead report and computed.

kindHint.fs_draft: Current year and prior year lines come from the mapped trial balance (reload leads). To compare a note with its face line, add an input with category Note total, key note_<lead code> (for example note_ppe) and the note total you prepared.
kindHint.lease_ifrs16: Enter payment as an amount, periods (whole number), rate_per_period (the entity's discount rate per period, e.g. 0.005) and timing (arrears or advance) as text values. Optional amounts: initial_direct_costs, prepaid_payments, incentives.

losses.balanceHint: The sum of all entries below. Each entry is recorded by a person or posted from a signed-off workpaper.
losses.emptyHint: Record losses incurred, used or forfeited, or post them from a signed-off corporate tax workpaper.
losses.noteHint: Say where the figure comes from, for example the return or workpaper reference.

tp.partiesHint: Parties this entity transacts with that a reviewer has identified as related or connected.
tp.jurisdictionHint: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 code, for example AE.
tp.removePartyDescription: "{{name}}" will be removed. This fails if transactions still refer to it.
tp.transactionsHint: Transactions with related parties, with the method and benchmark range a reviewer recorded.
tp.ratioRule: Enter a number with up to 6 decimal places.
tp.rangeBoth: Give both ends of the range, or neither.
tp.testedNeedsRange: A tested value needs a range.
tp.removeTxnDescription: The transaction with "{{name}}" will be removed.
tp.checkHint: Compares the period's related party totals with the thresholds in a rule pack. The result indicates what a reviewer may need to look at.
tp.disclosureNeedsPeriod: Enter a period to download the disclosure CSV.

portal.title: My requests
portal.description: Information your audit team has asked you to provide. Upload the files for each request, then submit it for review.
portal.fileHint: PDF, DOCX or TXT. Files are checked for type, size and signature before they are accepted.
portal.needFile: Upload at least one file before submitting.
portal.emptyHint: When your audit team asks you for information, the request appears here.
portal.staffOnlyTitle: This page is for client contacts
portal.staffOnlyHint: Team members raise and review requests from the PBC tab of an engagement.

engagements.title: Engagements
engagements.description: Audit engagements: planning, trial balance and lead schedules, risks and procedures, sampling, confirmations, adjustments, client requests and the management letter.
engagements.disclaimer: Saqient organises audit evidence and calculations for the engagement team. It does not form an audit opinion; every conclusion is the team's professional judgement.
engagements.newHint: An engagement starts in planning for one legal entity and period. Its currency is the entity's functional currency.
engagements.noEntitiesHint: Add a legal entity first; every engagement belongs to one.
engagements.name: Name
engagements.emptyHint: A reviewer or admin creates engagements.
engagements.emptyHintDecider: Create an engagement to plan the audit of an entity and period.
engagements.refRule: Use 1 to 20 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
engagements.amountRule: Enter an amount of zero or more with up to 4 decimals.
engagements.moveDescription: The engagement moves forward one phase. Moving back later needs a reason.
engagements.closeDescription: Closing the engagement locks its records. Reopening needs a reason.
engagements.backHint: Say why. The reason is kept in the audit log.

team.title: Team
team.hint: Members of this organisation assigned to the engagement, with the hours they recorded.
team.removed: Member removed. Their recorded hours stay on the engagement.
team.removeDescription: {{name}} leaves the engagement team. Hours already recorded stay.

hours.title: Budget and actual hours
hours.hint: Budgeted hours per phase against the hours the team recorded.
hours.varianceNote: Variance is budget minus actual; a negative value is an overrun. The used share is actual divided by budget, as calculated by the server.
hours.budgetHint: Hours per phase, up to 2 decimals.
hours.hoursRule: Enter hours with up to 2 decimals.

time.title: Time entries
time.hint: Team members record their own hours against a phase.
time.hoursRule: Enter more than 0 and at most 24 hours, up to 2 decimals.
time.deleteDescription: The hours are removed from the engagement totals.

tb.setupHint: Choose the current and prior-year trial balance of the entity, and the published rule pack the audit workpapers read.
tb.noTbs: This entity has no ready trial balance datasets yet. Import one from Datasets.
tb.packAndPrefix: Choose both a rule pack and a prefix, or neither.
tb.reportEmptyHint: Add lead schedules and map trial balance accounts to them.
tb.noAccounts: No accounts mapped to this schedule.
tb.netHint: A balanced trial balance nets to zero.
tb.unmapped_one: {{count}} account is not mapped to a lead schedule
tb.unmapped_other: {{count}} accounts are not mapped to a lead schedule
tb.missing_one: {{count}} mapped account is in neither trial balance
tb.missing_other: {{count}} mapped accounts are in neither trial balance
tb.schedulesHint: Codes are stored upper case. A schedule with mapped accounts cannot be removed.
tb.noSchedulesHint: Add the financial statement areas you will audit.
tb.scheduleRule: Each schedule needs a code of 1 to 20 letters or digits and a name.
tb.mappingsHint: Map trial balance account codes to lead schedule codes.
tb.mappingRule: Each row needs an account code and a lead schedule.
tb.workpapersHint: Lead schedule workpapers are filled from the lead report; materiality workpapers start empty for the team's benchmark, percentages and rationale.
tb.needPack: Choose the engagement's rule pack first.

risks.registerHint: Risks of material misstatement by financial statement area and assertion.
risks.dialogHint: Record the risk, the assertions it affects and the planned response.
risks.deleteDescription: Risk {{ref}} and its links to procedures are removed.

procedures.title: Audit procedures
procedures.hint: Procedures respond to risks. Marking one done needs a written conclusion.
procedures.dialogHint: Describe the procedure and link the risks it responds to.
procedures.emptyHint: Add procedures or apply an audit programme.
procedures.conclusionHint: Write the conclusion this procedure supports.

coverage.title: Risk coverage
coverage.hint: Procedures per risk. Counts only; it does not judge whether the work is sufficient.
coverage.significantOpen: Significant or fraud risks without a completed procedure

programme.title: Apply an audit programme
programme.hint: Creates one procedure per requirement of a published audit programme checklist; requirements already planned are skipped.

reviews.title: Linked reviews
reviews.hint: Confirmed findings of linked reviews can go on the management letter.

sampling.title: Samples
sampling.hint: Selections are reproducible: the seed, parameters, algorithm version and a SHA-256 of the population are recorded.
sampling.newHint: Choose the population (a ready dataset of this entity and an amount column) and the method.
sampling.noDatasets: This entity has no ready datasets to sample from.
sampling.name: Name
sampling.sizeRule: Enter a whole number from 1 to 5000.
sampling.strataHint: Each stratum takes amounts up to its upper bound (leave the last one empty for no limit). Leave the size empty to test every item in the stratum.
sampling.strataRule: Add at least one stratum; bounds are amounts and sizes are whole numbers.
sampling.seedHint: Optional. 4 to 64 letters, digits, dashes or underscores; a random one is generated when empty.
sampling.seedRule: Use 4 to 64 letters, digits, dashes or underscores.
sampling.itemsHint: Record the audited value of each item. A difference from the book value is an exception and needs a note.
sampling.noteHint: Required when the audited value differs from the book value.
sampling.projectionHint: Calculated by the server from the tested items; every step is shown.
sampling.noMateriality: No signed-off materiality workpaper yet, so the projection is not compared with performance materiality.
sampling.exceeds: The projected misstatement is at or above performance materiality ({{pm}}).
sampling.below: The projected misstatement is below performance materiality ({{pm}}).
sampling.conclusionHint: Every item must be tested before the sample is concluded.

confirmations.title: Confirmations
confirmations.hint: External confirmations: planned, sent, responded or no response, then closed with a conclusion.
confirmations.newHint: Amounts are in the engagement currency ({{currency}}).
confirmations.referenceHint: Do not enter bank account numbers or IBANs.
confirmations.moveHint: Choose the next status and give the details it needs.

adjustments.title: Adjustments schedule
adjustments.hint: Proposed adjustments, recorded by the client or passed. Effects follow the account mapping.
adjustments.dialogHint: Each line has a debit or a credit; debits and credits must balance.
adjustments.linesRule: Each line needs an account code and an amount; add at least two lines.
adjustments.balanceHint: The server checks that the lines balance.
adjustments.unmapped: Accounts not mapped to a lead schedule: {{accounts}}

toHint.recorded: The client has booked this adjustment.
toHint.passed: Left unbooked; it appears on the summary of unadjusted differences. A reason is required.
toHint.proposed: Say why the decision is reopened.

sud.title: Summary of unadjusted differences
sud.hint: Passed adjustments with their profit and net assets effects, against the latest signed-off materiality workpaper.
sud.judgementNote: A comparison only. Whether the differences are material is the engagement team's judgement.

pbc.title: Client requests (PBC)
pbc.hint: Items requested from the client. A request assigned to a client contact appears in their portal.
pbc.newHint: Assign it to a user with the client contact role so they can answer it in the portal.
pbc.noClients: No client contacts in this organisation. Invite one from Settings.
pbc.acceptHint: The request is complete. A note is optional.
pbc.rejectHint: Say what is missing; the client can upload more and resubmit.

letter.title: Management letter
letter.hint: Points come from confirmed findings of the engagement's linked reviews. Proposed and dismissed findings are never included.
letter.issued: Letter issued as a new version.
letter.issueDescription_one: The {{count}} included point is frozen as the next immutable version.
letter.issueDescription_other: The {{count}} included points are frozen as the next immutable version.
letter.missingRecommendation_one: {{count}} included point has no recommendation yet; write one before issuing.
letter.missingRecommendation_other: {{count}} included points have no recommendation yet; write them before issuing.
letter.emptyHint: Link reviews to the engagement, confirm findings, then add them here.
letter.pointHint: The observation comes from the finding. Write the recommendation and record management's response.
letter.versionsHint: Each issue is an immutable snapshot.

assurance.reasonHint: At least 3 characters. It is kept in the audit trail.
assurance.segregationHint: A reviewer or admin who did not prepare it signs off. Sign-off records a person's decision; it is not a certification of compliance.
assurance.reopenHint: Signed-off versions stay unchanged. The next sign-off creates a new version.
assurance.versionsHint: Each sign-off freezes an immutable snapshot that can be exported.

done.sign-off: Signed off. A new version was saved.

assurance.prefixHint: The rule key prefix in the chosen pack (tolerances, thresholds and buckets are read from it).
assurance.noReadyDatasets: No ready datasets of this kind

recs.title: Reconciliations
recs.description: Bank, account and intercompany reconciliations prepared from your datasets, with matching, variance checks and sign-off.
recs.disclaimer: Matches and variances are computed deterministically from the imported data. A person reviews them and decides; nothing here is a compliance conclusion.
recs.name: Name
recs.explanationRequired: The difference is over the threshold, so an explanation is needed before sign-off.
recs.codesRequired: Enter at least one account code.
recs.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with up to 4 decimals.

bank.newHint: Reconciles a bank statement version with ledger lines of the given GL accounts for the period. The auto-match runs with the rule pack's tolerance and date window.
bank.accountLabelHint: A name for the account. Do not enter account numbers or IBANs.
bank.closingBalanceHint: Leave empty to use the last balance on the statement.
bank.emptyHint: Import a bank statement and a general ledger, then create a reconciliation.
bank.note: Automatic matches are proposals from fixed rules. Review them, match the rest by hand with a reason, and sign off only when the difference is explained.
bank.autoMatched: Auto-match finished. Manual matches were kept.
bank.proofHint: Each step shows its inputs. Matcher {{matcher}}.
bank.unmatchedHint: Age is counted to the period end.
bank.unmatchHint: The lines return to the unmatched lists.
bank.matchHint: {{bank}} bank and {{book}} book lines. Their totals must agree within the pack's tolerance; the server checks this.
bank.noClosing: The statement closing balance is unknown.
bank.differenceBlocks: The difference must be zero before sign-off.

account.newHint: One reconciliation is created per account code from the chosen trial balance.
account.codesHint: Separated by commas. Each code becomes its own reconciliation.
account.emptyHint: Create reconciliations from a ready trial balance.
account.supportHint: Items that substantiate the balance. The variance is the balance less their total.

ic.newHint: Compares the balances two entities hold with each other on their trial balances.
ic.emptyHint: Needs ready trial balances for both entities.

close.title: Close
close.description: Period-end close checklists and flux reviews of trial balance movements.
close.newHint: Each checklist item becomes a task with a due date counted from the period end.
close.copyFromHint: Copies titles, day offsets and owners.
close.itemsHint: {{done}} of {{total}} done. Item status is the status of its task.
close.emptyHint: Create a close for a period end and add its checklist.
close.closeHint: Every item must be done or cancelled. A note is optional.
close.reopenHint: Say why it needs to be reopened.
close.pendingItems_one: {{count}} item is not done or cancelled yet.
close.pendingItems_other: {{count}} items are not done or cancelled yet.

flux.newHint: Compares two trial balances account by account and flags changes over the rule pack's thresholds.
flux.sameTb: Choose two different trial balance versions.
flux.emptyHint: Needs two ready trial balance versions.
flux.note: A flagged change is a prompt to explain, not a finding. Explanations are written and reviewed by people.
flux.explainHint: Describe what caused the change. An empty explanation removes it.
flux.unexplainedBlocks_one: {{count}} account over threshold has no explanation.
flux.unexplainedBlocks_other: {{count}} accounts over threshold have no explanation.

controls.title: Controls
controls.description: Processes, risks and controls, control testing, deficiencies and management certifications.
controls.disclaimer: Test conclusions and deficiency classifications are made by people. The product records them with their evidence; it does not judge control effectiveness.

process.newHint: A business process whose risks and controls you document.
process.name: Process
process.emptyHint: Create a process, then add its risks and controls.

controls.matrixHint: Risks without a mitigating control are highlighted.
controls.noRisksHint: Add the risks of this process.
controls.noRisksYet: Add risks first to link them here.
controls.noControlsHint: Add controls and link the risks they mitigate.
controls.addRiskHint: Describe what could go wrong and rate it.
controls.addControlHint: Describe the control and link the risks it mitigates.
controls.refRule: Up to 20 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.

test.addHint: Plan the test and attach the dataset rows you examined as evidence.
test.evidenceHint: A ready dataset version and the row ids that support the test.
test.completeHint: Record your conclusion, the exceptions found and why.

def.title: Deficiency
def.classifyHint: Your classification and rationale are recorded with your name.
def.remediationHint: Creates a task for the owner with the due date.
def.remediatedHint: Describe how it was remediated and how that was checked.
def.taskTitleHint: Optional; a title is generated when empty.
def.emptyHint: Deficiencies raised from control tests appear here.

cert.newHint: Management's statement on internal control for an entity and period, with the control results behind it.
cert.statementHint: Written by management. The product does not draft or certify it.
cert.emptyHint: Create one for an entity and period once controls are tested.
cert.note: The figures below summarise recorded test results. Signing off records management's statement; it is not an external assurance opinion.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Read-only imports from accounting systems into versioned datasets. Saqient never writes back to them.
connectors.notAvailableHint: Connectors are turned off for this deployment. Import datasets from files instead.
connectors.mappingNote: Field mappings have not been verified against live accounts (mapping status: unverified). Check imported rows against the source system before relying on them.
connectors.addHint: Only organisation admins manage connectors. Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again.
connectors.addedOdoo: Connector added. Test the connection next.
connectors.addedZoho: Connector added. Connect it to grant access.
connectors.baseUrlHint: The https address of your Odoo instance.
connectors.apiKeyHint: Use a key of a read-only user. It is stored encrypted and cannot be viewed later.
connectors.zohoHint: After adding, choose Connect to sign in to Zoho Books and grant read access.
connectors.syncQueued: Sync queued. A new dataset version appears when it finishes.
connectors.disconnectHint: Stored credentials are removed. Imported dataset versions are kept.
connectors.emptyHint: An organisation admin can add one.
connectors.emptyHintAdmin: Add Zoho Books or Odoo to import data read-only.
connectors.oauthFailed: The connection was not completed. Try Connect again.

packs.title: Content packs
packs.description: Sector packs of draft checklists and draft rules that you can install into this organisation as a starting point for review.
packs.listNote: Every pack here is synthetic draft content, not legal guidance. Installing a pack copies its checklists and rules as drafts; qualified people must review, verify and publish them before use.
packs.emptyHint: This deployment does not offer any content packs.
packs.openQuestionsHint: Questions the pack authors could not settle. They need a qualified person's answer before the related checks or rules are relied on.
packs.noOpenQuestions: This pack lists no open questions.
packs.installExplainer: Installing copies the pack's checklists and rules into this organisation as drafts. Nothing is published or verified automatically.
packs.noInstalls: This pack has not been installed in this organisation.
packs.installConfirm: This copies the pack's checklists and rules into this organisation as drafts. People must review, verify and publish them before they are used, and the pack does not certify compliance with anything.
packs.adminOnly: Only an organisation admin can install a pack.

agents.title: AI assistant
agents.description: Agents that draft explanations, letter wording, contract notes and answers from verified content. Every result is a draft for a person to accept or dismiss.
agents.explainer: Several agents work on each request: a specialist drafts, the app checks quotes, cited ids and numbers against the stored evidence, and a checking agent reads the draft against that evidence. Nothing changes until a reviewer accepts it. AI output is not legal advice and not a compliance decision.
agents.offHint: The deployment needs an AI provider and an organisation admin must opt in under Settings. Everything else in the app works without AI.
agents.unchecked: Not confirmed by the checking agent
agents.emptyHint: Ask a question above, or use Explain on a finding, Draft wording on a letter point, or Contract scan on a document.
agents.agentsHint: Reasoning agents use the larger model; fast agents use the lighter one.

contract.none: No passages were flagged with a verifiable quote.
contract.question: Question for the reviewer

qa.label: Ask about your verified rules and checklists
qa.placeholder: For example: which filing deadline applies to monthly VAT returns?
qa.hint: Answers use only rules and requirements your organisation has verified. If nothing verified covers the question, the assistant says so.
qa.question: Question
qa.insufficient: The verified content does not cover this question.
